technical_and_design_decisions: Native JDBC Source (U1) will be built using Spring Integration JDBC channel adapters, offering configurable polling intervals, SQL queries, and DataSource connections.
Redis Sink (U2) will leverage Spring Data Redis templates supporting key-value and payload structure mappings.
ZooKeeper Security (U3) will implement Digest/SASL authentication and ACL settings integrated into the Curator ZooKeeper client wrapper.
Trigger Abstraction (U4) will expose a clean Trigger SPI and dynamic extension mechanism allowing custom implementations to be registered via Spring application context.
Custom Module Example (U5) will be provided as a standalone reference project with AsciiDoc/Markdown documentation covering module creation guidelines.
Kafka Sink (U6) will be developed using Spring Kafka producer templates with configurable brokers, topics, key/value serializers, and partition strategies.
E2E Grunt Test Fix (U7) will address process concurrency, port availability, and server startup readiness hooks in the Grunt script workflow.
HTTPS for Admin Server (U8) will incorporate Spring Boot SSL configuration properties (`server.ssl.*`) after updating build scripts to include Spring Boot 1.1.7 SNAPSHOT/release.
assumptions: Development and testing will be conducted by a senior Java developer experienced with Spring Framework, Spring Integration, and node/grunt tooling.
Local or containerized test environments for databases, Redis, ZooKeeper, and Kafka are available for automated integration tests.
The Spring Boot build script updates for U8 will not cause breaking dependency conflicts across other system modules.
Standard documentation format (Markdown or AsciiDoc) is acceptable for user guidance in U5.

activities.activity_description: Develop native JDBC source module with support for custom DataSource configuration, polling queries, row mappers, and integration test suite.
Develop Redis sink module supporting configurable data structures (string, hash, list) and connection properties along with integration tests.
Configure ZooKeeper authentication (Digest/SASL) and ACL management for zNodes within the Curator client integration.

activities.activity_name: Refactor Trigger Abstraction for Custom Triggers (U4)
activities.activity_description: Expose public Trigger SPI, refactor existing triggers, and enable custom trigger class loading and configuration.

activities.activity_name: Create Custom Module Guide & Reference Project (U5)
activities.activity_description: Develop sample custom module demonstrating best practices and author comprehensive developer documentation.
Create Kafka sink module utilizing Spring Kafka producer components with configurable topic, key/value serialization, and delivery guarantees.

activities.activity_name: Fix Grunt E2E Test Execution & Socket Hangup (U7)
activities.activity_description: Investigate process lifecycle in Grunt tasks, fix socket hangup issue during concurrent server and protractor execution, and verify clean test runs.

activities.activity_name: Enable Admin Server HTTPS via Spring Boot Update (U8)
activities.activity_description: Update build configuration to Spring Boot 1.1.7 SNAPSHOT/release, expose SSL/TLS configuration properties for Admin server, and add HTTPS tests.
Perform end-to-end integration testing, full build verification, and prepare final software increment delivery.
